references.text: Moses set up the tabernacle (the tent of meeting) according to God's command
The glory of the Lord filled the tabernacle when it was set up
The land was divided by casting lots in front of the tent of meeting at Shiloh
The Levites came to the leaders at Shiloh to receive their cities
Shiloh is mentioned as the place where the tabernacle was located
The Lord's annual festival was held at Shiloh
Elkanah went to Shiloh to worship the Lord where the tabernacle stood
The ark of the covenant was brought from Shiloh
God mentions Shiloh as the place where he first let his name dwell
Prophecy that the temple will become like Shiloh
God abandoned the tabernacle at Shiloh, the tent he had set up among people
